method: Instrumented COPIES only (git archive HEAD snapshot): guest-gpu.c per-op write/wait/read timers (GUEST_GPU_PROF=1), vkgears.c per-frame record/submit/wait/x11 timers, host.mjs per-op idle/payload/handler/reply timers, renderer.mjs per-checked() action vs popErrorScope timers. Served from a shadow web root; no repo source changed.

environment.hostLoad: load average 0.68 at start, 2.59 at end; concurrent B2f agent possibly running guest gates on 4209/9419
environment.gate: pass (present/nopresent FPS, rotation screenshots, no page errors)

fps.noiseNote: Instrumented FPS matches uninstrumented V1 within ~3%; per-interval spread 57-67 / 178-191. Not repeated as a separate run.

host.note: Present slows unrelated ops (pass 3.47->4.38 ms, vertex popErrorScope 0.32->0.84 ms): the host runs serveGPU on the page main thread, which also paints the guest framebuffer, and the GPU process is busier.

optimisations.name: Drop per-op error scopes (one scope set per submit, or async error reporting)
optimisations.zinkConflict: None with B2f/B2c/B2b guest code; host.mjs is also edited by B2f, so land after B2f or rebase. Deferred errors need a reporting slot (next reply or fence wait), which B2b fences can carry.

optimisations.name: Pipelined fences: reply to GRAPHICS_PASS after queue.submit, await completion only at fence/WaitIdle/readback
optimisations.zinkConflict: Directly overlaps B2b (blocking waits/timeline semaphores): both need host-side completion tracking. Design it as part of B2b, not separately. Needs a frames-in-flight cap.

optimisations.name: Present path: no CPU upscale, direct BGRX from host, async (one-frame-late) readback ring with persistent staging
optimisations.zinkConflict: Readback ring touches B2f memory/suballocation (mapped readback buffers) and A6b present; vkgears.c change is app-only and conflict-free.

optimisations.name: One round trip per submit (batch uploads+pass+readback into one SUBMIT message)
optimisations.zinkConflict: Touches the same execute_submit code as B2f buffers and B2c push constants (push constants would ride in the batch). Do after B2f/B2c.

optimisations.name: Dirty tracking: skip unchanged vertex uploads (63.3 KB/frame, static after frame 1)
optimisations.zinkConflict: Strong overlap with B2f suballocation: tracking must be per suballocated range of host-backed memory. Implement inside B2f's buffer layer (flush ranges or shadow compare).

optimisations.name: Move serveGPU into a dedicated Worker (isolate from main-thread framebuffer painting)
optimisations.zinkConflict: None in guest; Firefox-mode GPU host shares gputest.mjs.

optimisations.name: Cache bind groups per (pipeline, uniform buffer, range)
optimisations.zinkConflict: B2c push constants (if emulated via UBO + dynamic offsets) changes bind group keys; do with B2c.

optimisations.name: Persistent host vertex/uniform buffers
optimisations.note: Already persistent: buffers are created once (ops 18/20) and only writeBuffer runs per frame (0.03-0.05 ms).

projected.nopresent: 5.2 ms -> ~1.3 ms with ranks 1,2,4,5 (GPU latency then bounds throughput; needs a frames-in-flight cap)
projected.present: 16.8 ms -> ~10.7 ms with ranks 1,2 (~93 FPS); ~5.7 ms adding rank 3 (~175 FPS, near softpipe 202)
